verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI insights or suggestions generated from merchant data. The docs AI-assistant links only explain documentation page content. The MCP server lets an external AI agent connect to dLocal, which is a developer building block rather than in-product insights. The dashboard's 'detailed reports' are not described as AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
